[EN] All the rebels still in their right mind have surrendered.

The rest, though..."The rest...?"
[ES] Todos los rebeldes que aún conservan la razón se han rendido.

Los demás, sin embargo..."The rest...?"

[EN] Well, the rest have become monsters. They're sick, and they're hurting people.

That's actually why I was glad you showed up. We need help.

Find the {@linkcreature:19#4000#Lokian ragers}, {@linkcreature:19#4003#Lokian gutreavers}, and {@linkcreature:19#4006#Lokian Bloodweavers} near this camp and drive them away.
[ES] Bueno, los demás se han convertido en monstruos. Están enfermos y están lastimando a la gente.

De hecho, por eso me alegré de que aparecieras. Necesitamos ayuda.

Encuentra los {@linkcreature:19#4000#Lokian ragers}, {@linkcreature:19#4003#Lokian gutreavers} y {@linkcreature:19#4006#Lokian Bloodweavers} cerca de este campamento y ahuyéntalos.

[EN] I don't know what took their minds, but so help me, we'll figure it out.
[ES] No sé qué les hizo perder la cabeza, pero te juro que lo averiguaremos.
